mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_application_log ( user_id, policy_id, source, notification_send_id, action, user_agent, ip_address ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{policyId}, #{source}, #{notificationSendId}, #{action}, #{userAgent}, #{ipAddress}::inet )
